Mobile boat detailing: wash, wax, compounding, oxidation removal, teak and vinyl

Florida sun chalks gelcoat in a season. Mobile detailers compound, polish, and seal the hull and deck at your slip or driveway, and keep it that way on a schedule.

What's included

  • Wash and salt removal
  • Compound and polish to remove oxidation
  • Wax or ceramic sealant
  • Vinyl and upholstery cleaning and conditioning
  • Teak cleaning and oiling
  • Metal polish, isinglass care
  • Monthly or quarterly maintenance plans
When

Twice a year minimum in Florida; monthly washes for slip-kept boats.

Time on site

3 to 8 hours

What it usually costs here

About $15 to $30 per foot for a full compound and wax; washes from $5 to $8 per foot; plans discounted.

In Tampa Bay specifically

Slip-kept boats at St. Petersburg, Clearwater Beach, and Tampa marinas are the bulk of wash plans.

Questions we get

Can you detail at the marina?

Yes where the marina allows outside vendors; the detailer carries insurance and follows the marina's wash rules.
